title: Migrate P0.6 automatic mutation triggers to generic control
objective: After proven WU11 parity, migrate the P0.6 pull-request and main-push trigger surface to ci-mutation, retire the legacy P0.6 workflow, and transition the P0.6 profile from parity-reference lifecycle to generic-control lifecycle without changing mutation score or test semantics.
non_goals: modify code-quality.yml embedded institutional mutation assurance
define or adopt the Lot45 mutation profile
modify Lot45 candidate or business code
change P0.6 mutation target tests score formula threshold timeouts or do-not-mutate semantics
introduce paid services or mandatory LLM review

outputs.name: Generic mutation workflow with main/PR P0.6 triggers

forbidden_semantics: P0.6 mutation score test target or threshold weakening

required_invariants: WU11 parity evidence status remains PASS and binds successful generic execution at af93cac4387b93865080a732c88ab8fd6eebeea0
generic ci-mutation gains pull_request main and push main P0.6 automatic coverage before legacy workflow retirement
generic trigger path surface contains every original P0.6 selector with legacy workflow path replaced by ci-mutation.yml
engineering branch mutation-maintenance trigger remains available during ENG-09.3
legacy p06-extended-mutation.yml is deleted only after generic trigger migration is present in the same commit
P0.6 registry lifecycle becomes GENERIC_CONTROL_ACTIVE_AFTER_WU12 and retains retired legacy workflow blob as provenance only
validator requires legacy workflow absence and validates the generic trigger surface after migration
P0.6 mutation source target tests also-copy settings score formula threshold and source binding remain unchanged
code-quality.yml and Lot45 mutation workflow remain unchanged
business development remains PAUSED and Lot46 remains LOCKED
acceptance_criteria: ci-mutation pull_request main paths cover P0.6 source tests requirements pyproject and ci-mutation workflow
ci-mutation push includes main and engineering/bootstrap-development-engine and the same P0.6 trigger paths plus mutation-engine maintenance paths
workflow_dispatch remains available with P06_DECISION_EVIDENCE as the only WU12 profile option
p06-extended-mutation.yml is absent from HEAD after migration
validate_mutation_profiles.py and selftest_mutation_profiles.py pass in migrated lifecycle
generic runner selftest and validate-only remain green
Security Actions Security Supply Chain Security Secrets and Engineering Bootstrap pass on migration head
CI Mutation Profiles executes successfully on the migration head
code-quality embedded mutation and Lot45 mutation assurance are byte-identical to scope base

done_when: P0.6 automatic triggers are owned only by the generic mutation workflow
P0.6 profile semantics remain parity-equivalent except for lifecycle and self-workflow selector migration
institutional and Lot45 mutation assurance remain untouched
